## Why This Issue Instead of a PR?

Opening a Pull Request yourself is faster and preferred, see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md). Only use this issue if you're
not comfortable with Git/GitHub yet and would like the maintainer to add
the row for you.
